title: Girls in Motion Puzzle Vol. 1: Hiyake no Omoide + Himekuri
native_title: 日灼けの想い出＋姫くり
overview:
Three kinds of puzzle modes and sexy live-action movies and photos of five beauties in swimsuits! Both will keep you puzzling!

Girls in Motion Puzzle Vol. 1 is a jigsaw puzzle game built around live-action footage and photos of swimsuit models.

- Movie Puzzle: the jigsaw pieces are moving video. Each girl has four scenes of rising difficulty, and clearing them all brings a reward
- VS Puzzle: race a friend or the computer to complete the same picture. Whoever places more pieces wins, and helper items can swing the match
- Himekuri Puzzle: using the Saturn's internal clock, a different photo puzzle appears every day for a whole year, like a page-a-day calendar, drawn from 366 stills of 50 women
- One or two players, Shuttle Mouse compatible, memory backup saves

3種類のパズルモードと5人の水着美女のセクシーな実写ムービー＆フォト！
どちらもキミを悩ますぞぉ！
